text:
Asha: FYI spotted repeated p95 regressions on embeddings when the ingress batcher packs mixed dims (128 + 1536). noticed it during a customer run.
Diego: Can you paste a short trace?
Asha: linked in the thread (cust-id=redwood-42). Batcher decisions show fill-rate wins and we end up with hybrid batches ~2x work.
Miriam: Is that caused by the splitter not running? I thought splitter would separate different vector sizes.
Praveen: Splitter only applies when client calls /split or if preflight flags it. The ingress packer currently optimizes for bytes to maximize throughput.
Asha: The tradeoff is harmful for latency-sensitive tenants. p95 increases a lot because the runtime kernel switches for large dims.
Diego: Two mitigations: expose a routing hint header to prefer dim-homogeneous pools, or change packer to prefer homogenous dims above a threshold.
Miriam: Header sounds easy: `x-embed-route-hint: prefer-homogeneous` or `prefer-packing-efficiency`. ingress router can honor it.
Praveen: We'll also need a console-level toggle per-tenant to enable/disable honoring hints. And document the latency vs cost implication.
Asha: Telemetry request: add `embed.batch_dim_entropy` and `embed.batch_primary_dim` tag so we can correlate entropy -> p95.
Diego: I'll add a gauge for batch_dim_entropy and a histogram for `embed.batch_tokens` with p50/p95 buckets. Also include `route_hint` tag.
Miriam: Billing question: if a tenant uses a dim-specific pool that packs differently, is unit accounting identical? We should show an estimated multiplier in preflight.
Praveen: Agree. Runtime may run different packing kernels; suggest exposing `unit_multiplier` in the preflight API so quota forecasts reflect the expected cost.
Asha: Console should show that multiplier in the route configuration and in the quota projection chart.
ConsoleBot: [deploy-bot] flag `routing.dim_hint_toggle` created in staging.
Diego: Proposed schedule: week 1 header + metrics; week 2 preflight multiplier + API contract; week 3 console toggle, docs, and canary rollout. 2-week A/B.
Miriam: Canary plan: 5% sample using hint vs default. Add an alert if p95 doesn't improve by at least 5% in the canary window.
Praveen: I'll own runtime heuristics and the preflight multiplier calc.
Asha: I'll own console copy and docs, and coordinate with product.
Diego: I'll own telemetry + canary plumbing and write the RFC.
Miriam: Quick API sample for customers (experimental):
```
POST /v1/embeddings
Headers:
  Authorization: Bearer $KEY
  Content-Type: application/json
  x-embed-route-hint: prefer-homogeneous
Body:
  {"input": [[...],[...]], "dims": [128, 128, 1536]}
```
Asha: Add helpful 4xx when a tenant hasn't enabled hints: `422 Unsupported routing hint for tenant` with a link to the console flag.
Praveen: Telemetry naming: keep it under `embed.*` and add `route_hint` and `batch_primary_dim` tags for slicing.
ConsoleBot: noted creating feature flags `routing.dim_hint_toggle` and `routing.show_unit_multiplier` for QA.
Diego: Suggest a new dashboard card: "Embedding routing heatmap" plotting batch_dim_entropy vs p95 with tenant filter. Useful during canary.
Miriam: SDKs should ignore unknown headers gracefully for forward-compat.
Asha: Owners confirmed: runtime: Praveen, telemetry/canary: Diego, console/docs: Asha + product. I'll open the tracking ticket and add the owners.
Praveen: I'll try a soft-avoid-mixing heuristic branch next week to gather numbers.
Diego: I'll attach incident traces and preliminary graphs in the RFC.
Miriam: 44d Will review RFC once it's up.
Asha: Thanks all, followups in the ticket. :thumbsup:
